items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: That's the lady that married Benny Spellman. Emerette. Yeah, Emerette. Yeah, that's who. Emerette who? Emerette, who? Emerette Rie. Or H-E-A. Well, anyway, she wanted to be my girlfriend.

ctx.x: So how long were you in Okinawa? I was on Okinawa, I think I was on Okinawa about

11 months. 11 months. Because we secured the island completely. And then they started rebuilding. You see, and I was on Okinawa when World War II ended. And I don't know if you remember reading about the first, the false alarm, when they said the war was over, it was a false alarm. And boy, we celebrated that night. And then it was a false alarm. But the next week it was real. And everybody, all we could think of, oh boy, I'm going home. You know, glad to be alive and going home. How did you celebrate the ending…
